note: Every message the engine can raise. text is a template: {name}, {n}, {resource}, {wave}, {planet}, {text}, {reason}, {from}, {to} are filled from the payload. importance 1 is chatter, 5 is 'drop what you are doing'. jumpTo true means the UI should offer a camera jump to `at`. Anything at 4 or 5 deserves to interrupt.

landed.text: Landing pod down on {planet}. {n} crew, and everything else is up to you.

node_found.text: Scan found {resource} - {n} units in the patch.

rare_found.text: That is {resource}. This world has something the others do not.

node_depleted.text: The {resource} patch under {name} is empty. The drill is standing idle.

build_started.text: Outline placed: {name}. Builders are on the way.

no_materials.text: Builders are stalled on {name} - short of {resource}.

brownout.text: Grid at {n}% - everything is running slow. You need more generation or fewer machines.

machine_full.text: {name} has stopped - its output has nowhere to go.

route_created.text: Route running: {resource} from {from} to {to}, about {n} seconds a trip.

route_blocked.text: No path for the {resource} run to {to}. Something is in the way, or there is water between them.

vehicle_lost.text: {name} was destroyed on the road. The load is gone with it.

threat_rising.text: Something is circling. Threat is at {n} and climbing.

wave_incoming.text: Wave {wave} inbound from the {name} - {n} of them.

wall_breached.text: The wall is open near {name}. They are inside.

nest_found.text: Nest spotted {n} tiles out. It will keep raising the threat until it is gone.

hazard_storm.text: Storm front rolling in. Wind power is up, everything outdoors is taking damage, and something may ride in with it.

hazard_cold.text: Deep cold. Unheated machines are seizing up - keep the power on.

hazard_radiation.text: Radiation spike near {name}. Crew out there are taking damage.

hazard_ashfall.text: Ash fall. Solar output is halved until it clears.

satellite_up.text: Satellite in orbit. The whole world map is yours, and orbital research is open.

rocket_ready.text: The rocket is assembled. Load the hold and it can leave whenever you are ready.

station_complete.text: The orbital station is crewed and turning. Cargo goes up on the lift from here on.

beacon_lit.text: Beacon lit on {planet}. That is {n} of {text} worlds claimed.

victory.text: The beacon chain is complete. The frontier is yours - {n} worlds, all of it built from the ground up.

defeat.text: The landing pod is gone. There is nothing left on {planet} to build from.

hazard_heat.text: Heat wave. Machines are running {n}% slower and anyone outside is cooking.

hazard_toxic.text: The air has turned. Anything outside a filter's reach is corroding - chemical plants and med bays cover a circle around themselves.

hazard_quake.text: Ground shock. Everything is taking damage and the roads are cracking.

hazard_overgrowth.text: Everything is growing back at once. Good for the harvesters, hard on the walls.

hazard_lowlight.text: The cloud deck has closed over. Solar is down to a third until it lifts.

hazard_pressure.text: Pressure front. Machines are labouring and the seals are complaining.

hazard_tide.text: High tide running. Anything near the water is taking damage, and something may come in with it.

hazard_dust.text: Dust fall out of the dark. Solar is halved and the panels are pitting.

hazard_sheltered.text: {n} crew are under cover and riding this one out.

builder_idle.text: {n} builders have had nothing to do for a while. Place something, or put them on a yard.

nest_wanderers.text: Something came out of the nest on its own - {n} of them, wandering in.

tech_granted.text: {name} read straight off the find - that node is done without paying for it.

element_available.text: {resource} is on this world, which means {name} can be researched here and nowhere else.

scarce_found.text: A thin seam of {resource} - {n} units. This archetype does not normally carry it, so this is all there is.

route_stalled.text: The {resource} run has been sitting at the loading bay with nothing to load.

vehicle_upgraded.text: {name} upgraded to tier {n} - bigger load, quicker trip.

road_done.text: {n} tiles of {name} laid on the main run.

wave_repelled.text: Wave {wave} broke on the line. {n} killed, nothing of ours lost.

wave_quiet.text: Nothing on the sensors for a while. Next one is roughly {n} minutes out - build something.

satellite_online.text: Satellite uplink online. Orbital science packs are available and every patch on the ground is on the chart.

input_starved.text: {n} machines are all waiting on {resource}. Widen that chain or dig another patch.

storage_pressure.text: Stores are {n}% full. Anything that cannot be put down stops the machine that made it.

power_short.text: Generation is {n} kW behind demand. The factory is being shed first; the drills and the guns keep their power.
